title: Hunyuan3D 2.1 image to 3D
description: Local image-to-mesh workflow from the official ComfyUI template. Produces an untextured GLB mesh of the main subject; used by Camera angles to render true viewpoints from real geometry. A product fixture produced a 10.6 MB GLB in 76 s on RTX 4090 / 64 GB RAM.

requirements.instructions: Install the pinned 7,365,943,290-byte Hunyuan3D 2.1 checkpoint on G: and verify its SHA-256. Its license does not apply in the EU, UK or South Korea.

evidence: 2026-10-23: official template converted to 10 API nodes; direct native run on a teal-cup product fixture succeeded in 76 s and wrote comfyfield-h3d-test_00001_.glb (10,594,396 bytes). Mesh is untextured. Other subjects and app-ledger runs remain unproven.
